import { defineTable, col } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "version" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
export const schemaMigrations = defineTable("schema_migrations", {
    columns: {
        version: col.text().primaryKey()
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
